description: Turn part of a saved step's OBJECT locator into a "Parameter of object", as the SimplifyQA editor does: e.g. step 7 clicks the object whose locator is //a[normalize-space()='PIM'] — pass `replace:"PIM"`, `parameterName:"menu_name"` and the locator becomes //a[normalize-space()='{{<id>}}'], the step shows menu_name under "Parameter of object", and the test-data cell holds PIM. The recorder cannot do this itself. WITHOUT `confirm:true` it only reports what would change. The object is SHARED: other steps and test cases that use it will resolve the same parameter, so they need a value for it too. Reads the test data back and says whether the value is stored.

confirm.description: true = write it. Omit to preview.

locator.description: Only rewrite the locator with this name (e.g. "Xpath by Role and Name"). Default: every locator containing the text.

parameterName.description: Name of the parameter, e.g. menu_name. Created if it does not exist.

replace.description: The text inside the locator to turn into the parameter, when it differs from `value`.

step.description: 1-based number of the step whose object holds the locator.

tcId.description: Test case id or code, e.g. TC-12862.

value.description: The value for the test-data cell, e.g. PIM. Also the locator text to replace unless `replace` is given.

versionId.description: A non-current version of the test case (id or name like v2.0).

name: object_parameterize
title: Parameterize an object locator (SimplifyQA)
